entities.summary: Velvet Revolution, a transformative movement in Armenia (1994–2020). Emerged from Armenian forces capture Shusha/Shushi and the Lachin corridor and Bishkek ceasefire agreement freezes the conflict. Catalyzed Post-War Challenges and Velvet Revolution and 44-day war ends with Armenian defeat and Russian peacekeepers.
